remarks: Located in St. Albert, residents enjoy scenic trails, green spaces, the Sturgeon River valley, and a vibrant community highlighted by the Perron District, festivals, and a strong arts scene. Cherot’s signature French-inspired architecture, top schools, excellent healthcare, and safe environment make it an outstanding place to call home. The home features an open concept main floor with 9’ ceiling and the designer L-shape kitchen, large island and corner pantry. Quartz countertops in the kitchen and all bathrooms. Large great room includes a 50” linear electric fireplace. The second floor has a large primary bedroom with walk-in closet and 4-piece ensuite that includes dual sinks and walk-in shower. This home also has two secondary bedrooms, central bonus room, full bathroom, and a conveniently located laundry upstairs. A side entrance is included for a potential basement development, with the basement ceiling height upgraded to 9’, for a more spacious feel, and 2 windows. (id:67522)
